title: Azotha
wikitext:
The '''Azotha''' were an ancient civilization to which [[humanity]] traces its early roots to.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/466626998593388579/838277039987097600 Gheor from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "The Azotha are the first men"</ref><ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1085159575046606850 Lhian from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "well, azotha are ancient predecessor to humans"</ref>

A shamanistic culture,<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/895751435797536788/1273330923764715654 Moriena from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "The current human predecessors, the Azotha, had shamanistic traits in their culture"</ref> they had established nations such as the kingdom of [[Corthan]] in the modern day [[Badlands]]<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1274061839482753157 Moriena from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "Corthan was a kingdom of the Azotha"</ref><ref>[[The History of Corthan]]</ref> and waged war against the Zandalari.<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|57|Azotha Gold}}</ref> However, the Azotha would later decline after the Sundering, and Corthan would eventually collapse and revert to a tribal state, with rebels fleeing north of the Badlands where they are believed to have established the Arathi dynasty.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1086439363199635568 Gheor from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "The Kingdom of Corthan predates the Arathor Empire. Corthan mentions rebels going up north of the now Badlands and implies they have gone back into a tribal state - thus being the first step towards the Empire of Arathor."</ref>
